actionsDir.description: The folder the user's own Sidekick actions are saved in, or "default" to go back to Documents/Sidekick Actions. Sidekick's action tools use the change from their next call, and pass it on to the Sidekick Actions panel in InDesign then.

observers.description: Allow local processes (a demo recorder, a session transcript) to watch commands sent to InDesign. Off by default.

pinned.description: Stay on the installed version: nothing is downloaded. Takes effect when each Sidekick server next starts. The next start runs the version installed with Sidekick, which can be older than the one running now.

sharedActionsDirs.description: Folders of actions to read in addition to the user's own, for example a studio's shared folder, in order of precedence. Sidekick never writes there; an action of the same name in the user's own folder replaces a shared one. An empty list clears them. Sidekick's action tools use the change from their next call, and pass it on to the Sidekick Actions panel in InDesign then.
